HOW TO PLAY

1. Player 1 attacks PLAYER 2 FLEET; Player 2 attacks PLAYER 1 FLEET.

2. Choose a square and make the sentence aloud.

3. Press CHECK to see the correct answer, then FIRE!

4. HIT = another turn! MISS = switch players.
